input_contract: All scenario IDs must be unique across cases in a build; facts describe one settled evaluation snapshot.
Absent optional cause/condition/resistance means absent within this complete scenario, not unknown.
Ability scores, target DC/base AC, selected ability/training, positions/visibility and settled dice are explicit external facts.
ReactionWindow is since the actor’s last turn start; Turn describes the current actor’s own turn.
Rule and claim annotations are assistant-authored, unreviewed; source coordinates do not imply approved rule identity.
DodgeActive means its duration has not ended; DodgeAttackerSeen is the defender’s sight of this attacker.
PassivePerception.modifier is the complete supplied perception modifier, including training and penalties.
Symbols are nonempty, at most 2048 characters, and exclude controls, double quotes and backslashes (Soufflé 2.5 proof serialization).
A build is one joint snapshot (and one initiative contest); use separate builds for independent encounters. Rank accepts integer levels/CR bands 1–30 only.
AvailableAction and DashExtra describe available options and their potential extra movement, not actions already executed. MovementCost does not maintain a movement budget.
